from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

# Verify the core issue: _simulate writes to storage during simulation
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)
db.insert({'x': 1})

# The _simulate method writes during iteration via self.db.storage.write()
# This is the root cause of both failures

# Test: does preview actually mutate storage?
import copy
original = copy.deepcopy(db.storage.memory)
result = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}])
print('Preview mutated storage:', db.storage.memory != original)
print('Preview result:', result)
print('DB after preview:', db.all())
